div.div: A pull decrypts with the same AAD, so a ciphertext served under another manifest id or category is refused. Data that changes often lives in data buckets, so a settings change does not require to upload the whole manifest again. The server keeps a limited number of older versions as a backup.

div.div: The salted address makes identical files in different vaults unrecognizable to the server, and lets every member of a shared vault compute the same address. Blob bytes are never encrypted with the VEK itself, only their blob key is. Blobs never change; a blob is deleted once no kept manifest version refers to it anymore.

text.tspan: The salted address makes identical files in different vaults unrecognizable to the server, and lets every member of a shared vault
compute the same address. Blob bytes are never encrypted with the VEK itself, only their blob key is. Blobs never change; a blob
is deleted once no kept manifest version refers to it anymore.
